description_en: Purchases Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances in the Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) console and adds the purchased ECS instances to the specified instance group of an application
description_zh: 在EDAS中代购ECS实例，并将代购的实例扩容到指定的应用分组
name: ScaleoutApplicationWithNewInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application that you want to scale out. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.help_zh: 扩容的目标应用ID，可通过调用ListApplication接口来获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group that you want to scale out. You can call the ListDeployGroup operation to query the group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62077.html
parameters.help_zh: 扩容应用的目标分组ID，可通过调用ListDeployGroup接口来获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62077.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to be added for the scale-out
parameters.name: scaling_num

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance launch template. You can call the DescribeLaunchTemplates operation to query the launch template ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html
parameters.help_zh: ECS启动模板ID，可通过调用DescribeLaunchTemplates接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73759.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the ECS instance launch template. You can call the DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions operation to query the launch template version. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73761.html.

If you set this parameter to `-1`, the default launch template version is used
parameters.help_zh:
ECS启动模板版本，可通过调用DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73761.html。

设置为`-1`代表使用默认的启动模板版本
parameters.name: template_version

parameters.help_en:
The instance reclaim mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

recycle: economical mode
release: release mode

For more information about how to remove instances from a specified scaling group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定伸缩组的回收模式，取值范围：

recycle：伸缩组的回收模式为停机回收模式。
release：伸缩组的回收模式为释放模式。

从一个伸缩组删除实例，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.name: scaling_policy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the existing ECS instance used for the scale-out. If this parameter is specified, the specifications and configurations of the specified ECS instance are used as a template to purchase new instances
parameters.help_zh: 扩容时使用的现有ECS实例ID，若填写此项，将以指定的ECS实例的规格和配置为模板来购买新的ECS实例
parameters.name: template_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster to which you want to add ECS instances. If the application and application instance group for the scale-out are specified, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 扩容的集群ID，若指定了应用和分组进行扩容，此参数将被忽略
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费方式。取值范围：
PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid（默认）：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:

Week: billed on a weekly basis.
Month: billed on a monthly basis. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月计费方式的时长单位。取值范围：

Week：按周计费。
Month（默认）：按月计费
parameters.name: instance_charge_period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the subscription. The unit of the subscription duration is specified by the InstanceChargePeriodUnit parameter. This parameter takes effect only when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid.

If the InstanceChargePeriodUnit parameter is set to Week, the valid values of the InstanceChargePeriod parameter are 1, 2, 3, and 4.
If the InstanceChargePeriodUnit parameter is set to Month, the valid values of the InstanceChargePeriod parameter are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60
parameters.name: instance_charge_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect only when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: does not enable auto-renewal. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否要自动续费。当参数InstanceChargeType取值PrePaid时才生效。取值范围：

true：自动续费。
false（默认）：不自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Valid values:

If the InstanceChargePeriodUnit parameter is set to Week, the valid values of the AutoRenewPeriod parameter are 1, 2, and 3.
If the InstanceChargePeriodUnit parameter is set to Month, the valid values of the AutoRenewPeriod parameter are 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
单次自动续费的续费时长。取值范围：

InstanceChargePeriodUnit=Week时：{“1”, “2”, “3”}。
InstanceChargePeriodUnit=Month时：{“1”, “2”, “3”, “6”, “12”, "24", "36", "48", "60"}。

默认值：1
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process for the scale-out

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

items.description_en: The list of purchased ECS instances

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
